overview: Luda is a strong woman who carries an exorbitant burden on fragile shoulders. She fights with her husband's drunkenness, brings up children, helps her friend and patiently stomachs her mother-in-law. But fate seems to test the heroine for strength, and the next blow is not a small-time trouble, but a real tragedy. Luda's husband tragically dies in a fire, and the house burns down. As if running amuck, her close ones drop their masks and betray the heroine - the mother-in-law refuses to give her shelter, and the best friend drives her into the street out of stupid jealousy. Will Luda be able to overcome all misfortunes and start life anew?
title: Я все преодолею

overview: The adventures of the special agent Aleksey Nikolaev.
title: Агент национальной безопасности

overview: In a small provincial town Tikhodonsk a former patient of mental hospital Sergey Lapin lives and he seems to be a quiet, modest man, although local people know that this weird man who lives together with a market seller, in fact is not that simple. Sergey is strong and emotional, and his anger can't be controlled by his consciousness. His life becomes different after he was run over by a head of technical support of the bank. Then bank officers realize that they can use his knowledge of new security systems, so they hire him. He gets his first salary and buys some new clothing - Sergey changes so amazingly. Smart chief of bank's security tests Sergey to find out other hidden resources of this person. Still, the man does not remember anything that could shed some light to his mystic past. But there are those who know about the danger this person can bring. They open the hunting season on Lapin, who decides to solve the mystery and get back his forgotten self.
title: Оперативный псевдоним

overview: The military operations taking place in the years 1965-1973 when a group of Russian military operatives carried out the advisory support of North Vietnam as well as covert operations to capture the spoils (the enemy's new war technologies) It is the story of a soldier named Paul who was sent from Moscow military school in Vietnam where he discovers a traitor among his colleagues. However, through a turn of events, he becomes a traitor in the eyes of the commander, and he has to run from his comrades to complete the operation and prove that he is not guilty. Along the way, he joins forces with a North Vietnamese man and an escaped military pilot. The three men make a plan to leave the territory of Vietnam but the road to freedom is full of dangers and surprises. In the end, Paul finds the original traitor and destroys him but he still has to prove his innocence.
title: Чужая война

overview: The Second World War. Leningrad was in blockade in the winter of 1941. The only way to deliver food and other supplies to the city is through the icy Lake Ladoga, the so-called "Road of Life". The path itself passes through the ice of the lake. But the Nazis are preparing a diversion along the way, and their informant is most likely a truck driver. To deal with this situation entrusted to the captain of the NKVD Sergienko.
title: Ладога

overview: Biopic about Russian engineer Vladimir Zvorykin, the inventor of television.
title: Зворыкин-Муромец

overview: Agatha Christie's crime thrillers featuring the author's much-loved spinster sleuth Miss Jane Marple.
title: Agatha Christie's Marple

overview: This film tells the story of the early years of the famous Soviet commander, Grigoriy Kotovskiy, during the decline of tsarism in Russia. As a student at agricultural college in 1900, Kotovskiy meets a group of graduates who pledge eternal friendship and loyalty to one another even though their lives quickly take very different paths. While Oles becomes a politician, and Aleksey rises to the rank of Police Commander, Viktor turns to a life of crime together with his friend, Grigoriy Kotovskiy, who becomes leader of a gang of robbers. As a youth Kotovskiy is headstrong, romantic and impetuous. Robbing the rich to give to the poor, he becomes known as the Robin Hood of Bessarabia, held in awe by everyone throughout Southern Russia. With a price on his head, it is only a matter of time before he is captured and sent to prison. But he manages to escape and soon returns to his already legendary life of crime. Encountering both true love and treachery along the way, Kotovskiy continues to uphold his own strict code of conduct honoring the promise once given to his friends.
title: Котовский

overview: The latest scientific developments and technologies that are capable of changing or are already changing our lives.
title: Чудо техники

overview: Saga about the Doroshins family. The action takes place in the war and post-war time. The characteristic features of the Doroshins family are hard work, courage and integrity. Pavel Nikolaevich - war veteran, chief designer of the plant, Anastasiya Mikhaylovna - head of Department of the University, an active participant in the partisan movement. Their eldest son, Ilya, a sanitary doctor, demands the liquidation of one of the enterprises in the city center. But war criminals, hiding from retaliation, know that the Gestapo archives are hidden in the basement of the building, and are afraid that documents may be discovered.
title: Личное счастье

overview: From the side of Olga's life, every woman could envy - a clever beauty, a wonderful husband, a loving son, her work. But the rich, as you know, also cry, and behind this picture of a happy life you cannot see what Olga does not have - love. Quite by chance, in the classroom at the equestrian club, Olga met the handsome and gallant Victor, who turned out to be a technologist.
title: Бабочки и птицы

overview: The story begins with Mazur's personal tragedy - his wife Olga is killed. Mazur finds out that the murderer of his wife is the owner of a hunting zaimka, where they arrange a hunt ... for people. Mazur intends to take revenge, but it is almost impossible to get to the killer. Mazur turns to his old friend General Glagolev for help. He is ready to help if the captain fulfills his task. There are videos on the hunting zaimka that compromise a US senator running for president. Mazur must get these materials for the American prosecutor, who intends to expose the senator.
title: След Пираньи

overview: Väinö, Ilmari and Lemminki, inspired by the tales in the Kalevala, go in search of a woman, eventually finding themselves at war with the Nordic people, and consider the great questions of life, their relationship to life, love and death.
title: Rauta-aika

overview: Sveta and Dima live in a wonderful town Blinov, in the touristic center of Russia. They both are about thirty, and they have two lovely kids: a seven-year-old Sanya and a toddler Lena. Sveta's mom, beautiful but lonely business-lady, owns a ceramic shop. Her daughter works there drawing traditional ornaments on cups and plates. Dima is a talented chef. But he loses his job again and again because of his culinary experiments and intolerance to violations of the quality and quantity of products. Dima does not give up: he still cooks pancakes for his friends and dreams about a restaurant on the riverside of Volga. Sveta is tired of instability and lack of money. And Olga doesn't like her son in law: she thinks that such a romantic looser doesn't suit her daughter. Unlike Petya, Sveta's classmate - he is a lawyer and seems to be successful. But one lucky day Sveta wins a lottery - almost 3 millions! She does not tell her husband about her unexpected wealth. All the money she won ... she invests into new restaurant. And this decision will cause a lot of problems for our heroes.
title: Тещины блины

overview: Home renovation looks so easy on TV. We see a project move quickly and smoothly from start to finish – and the results are always beautiful. But somewhere between "before" and "after" there are always at least a few speed bumps – and one great story. Budgets skyrocket, tempers flare, relationships suffer. This is real life, and DIY Network's Renovation Realities proves that even in home improvement, truth is often stranger than fiction.
title: Renovation Realities

overview: Travel of Vladimir Pozner and Ivan Urgant in France.
title: Тур де Франс

overview: Olga and Igor have been married for a long time, they have an adult daughter Masha. Nothing foreshadowed changes in their small Moscow apartment, until Igor became interested in his daughter's girlfriend, Ksyusha. Olga behaved decisively - put Igor out of the door and filed for divorce. Igor was forced to move in with his chosen one and her imposing mother Irina, his age. But soon he had to return to his wife's apartment. And then Masha fell in love, and, as luck would have it, her boyfriend Kirill turned out to be a nonresident. Living together in close quarters forces the heroes to look for an unusual way out of the situation. Parents decide to sacrifice themselves for the sake of their daughter's happiness and begin to look for new life partners who are not burdened with the "apartment issue".
title: Квартирка

overview: Professor Hannah Fry sets off on a global adventure, not just to see the world but to decode it. With curiosity, wit and insight she peels back the layers in six iconic locations: Spain, Vietnam, Greece, South Korea, Ireland, and Iceland. Through stunning landscapes, vibrant cities and off the beaten track treasures, Hannah seeks out extraordinary local voices and unexpected quirks of history and geography that reveal what makes each place truly unique. Always seeking patterns and hidden connections, she uncovers how Spain's destiny was shaped by mountains, analyses traffic etiquette in Ho Chi Minh City, reveals secrets hidden in the geometry at the Parthenon and how Irish syntax builds a world view. This is much more than a travelogue—it's a journey into the forces that shape nations and define cultures.
title: The Infinite Explorer with Hannah Fry

overview: A lighthearted look at student life with Bryan, Peter, Bob, and Vivien who share a flat in London.
title: The Eggheads

overview: In four rounds, several candidates compete against each other and simultaneously against the supposedly ‘unquizzable' Elton and Stefan Raab, who, however, always have to agree on an answer. Gradually, the number of challengers decreases until only the best remains to face the two entertainers in a direct final duel. Whoever manages to defeat Elton and Stefan Raab can win up to 100,000 euros.
title: Die Unzerquizbaren

overview: Following an incident that makes him question his future as a doctor, cardiothoracic surgeon Dr. Talodkarn decides to go provide government services in Yala. A twist of fate, however, lands him back at his previous hospital.
title: Once a Doctor, Always a Doctor

overview: The show revolves around the reporters and producers at a fictional television news magazine series, The Eleventh Hour. Unhappy with the news magazine's shrinking audience, the network has brought in a new executive producer, Kennedy Marsh, to reorient the show in a more ratings-driven tabloid journalism direction. The tension between the ratings imperative and the more traditional journalistic ethics of the show's senior staff is the primary conflict that drives the show, but story lines also include the team's efforts to get the stories that will make it to air each week.
title: The Eleventh Hour

overview: The almanac on the history of musical culture "Absolute Pitch" is an educational and engaging TV magazine that covers various musical styles and trends, genres and eras. The range of topics is extremely diverse: from the origins of a popular song to the history of creating a major musical masterpiece, from the nuances of opera or ballet productions to the biographies of outstanding composers and performers. The program is designed for the widest possible audience of music professionals and enthusiasts.
title: Абсолютный слух

overview: Valentin Nepomnyashchy's author's programme. The cycle is a lyrical confession by Alexander Sergeyevich Pushkin. By reading the poet's verses and providing explanations and remarks, the author shows how the poet's ideas about love, about women, about himself, about creativity, and about life develop — for love was for Pushkin a matter of life and death, the meaning of existence, the essence of creativity, and the purpose of human life. The cycle covers the entire creative life of Pushkin, starting from 1813.
title: А.С. Пушкин. Тысяча строк о любви

overview: In a border town, Fátima "The Collector" gives visitors objects from her eerie shop. These seemingly ordinary gifts harbor hidden supernatural powers.
title: La coleccionista

overview: 2012 marked the 200th anniversary of the Battle of Borodino and the expulsion of Napoleonic troops from the Russian Empire. The film continues the theme of the Patriotic War of 1812 and invites viewers to remember the events of 1813-1815, which are less known to a wider audience. This is a story about the path traveled by the Russian army from the burning of Moscow to Paris: about the battles of Dresden and Kulm, about the defeat of the French near Leipzig, about the military actions of Russian troops in France. The viewer will learn the details of Napoleon's abdication and his first exile to the island of Elba, the unexpected return of the French emperor, the hundred days of his reign and the final defeat of his army...
title: 1812-1815. Заграничный поход

overview: A large-scale reconstruction of the heroic events of the Patriotic War of 1812, in which Russia defeated Napoleonic France. The 4-episode project "1812" covers the main events of the war with Napoleon from the summer to the winter of 1812 - from the moment when the "great army" invaded the Russian Empire, until the moment when its remnants were driven back.

Kira, a charming and young-looking woman, marries her adult son and will soon become a grandmother. She is surrounded by good people, and at her job, too, everything is wonderful - In a word, everything is fine, except for personal life.. At the wedding, Kira presents to her son and his wife a week in an elite hotel, but the circumstances are such that the newlyweds are unable to go. As a result a lonely middle-aged lady checks into a honeymoon suite instead of a couple - the good trip can't go to waste. In this romantic atmosphere, Kira has a passionate and light affair herself. And everything would be fine, but having returned home happy Kira, to her utmost horror, discovers that she is pregnant..
title: Бабушка на сносях

overview: A Russian mystery drama series based on the book of the same name by Dmitriy Veresov.
title: Черный ворон

overview: The hosts meet at the dinner table with famous Italians. They tell the hosts about the main sights of Italy and the most significant local dishes and drinks. After that, the hosts visit the named places and taste these dishes.
title: Их Италия

overview: August 1944. The Soviet Department of Military Counterespionage is trying to identify an enemy secret agent. Dramatic events unfold as it becomes clear that the spy is one of the Soviet army's own men.
title: Смерть шпионам!

overview: A romantic story about love between Varya, figure skating world champion, and Vladimir, ice hockey star.
title: Две сестры

overview: The operatives of one of the police departments are on the trail of dangerous criminals every day. They face violent gangsters and uncover intricate combinations invented by criminals to cover up crimes. But each of the police officers of the department knows that there is always a reliable shoulder of a colleague nearby.
title: Вижу-знаю
Не жалею, не зову, не плачу

overview: The series, loosely comparable to the 1961 NBC hit Dr. Kildare, reveals the human stories of people who come to the psychiatrist either through private practice, a hospital, or a court of law. The first season hence offered episodes about the mental health of criminals. In the second season, Dr. Richard Starke took over as a psychiatrist engaged in private practice.
title: The Eleventh Hour

overview: After their father is lost at sea and their mother falls into a coma, three young siblings struggle against all to hold their family together.
title: Трое против всех

overview: The secret agent of the special services, Andrei Kozyrev, nicknamed the American, unjustly convicted of murder, once has a chance to change his life. He makes a daring escape from the colony to find his enemy, prove his innocence and save the world from a deadly new virus that threatens the death of millions of people.
title: Агент

overview: Based on the real story. After collapse of USSR former army officer don't know what to do with his life in new Russia. After some collisions with criminals he decided to join a gang by his own will.
title: Банды

overview: For the first time, cameras go behind the scenes at Toronto Pearson International, Canada's biggest and busiest airport. They reveal how the airport keeps millions of passengers and thousands of planes moving, even when facing record-breaking snowstorms and extreme winter weather. Technical issues, emergencies, security breaches and passenger demands pile even more pressure on the flight schedule.
title: Toronto Airport Uncovered

overview: A Russian sketch comedy show. The predecessor of "6 kadrov".
title: Дорогая передача

overview: Anna is torn between her love to Count Vronsky, and her loveless marriage to Mr. Karenin. Based on the book by Leo Tolstoy.
title: Анна Каренина

overview: The film is based on the biography of the legendary Russian ballerina Anna Pavlova. She became an internationally regarded ballerina after her performances in 1909 with the Dyaghilev's Ballet in Paris and in London. Anna Pavlova eventually formed her own troupe. She made a successful world tour together with Viktor d'Andre, who was her husband and manager.
title: Анна Павлова

overview: Zhenya Utopia and a unique experiment in which celebrity guests investigate murders, interrogate suspects, and sift through evidence. They are detectives whose job it is to find the culprits and uncover their motives. And it's not easy, as criminals are adept at covering their tracks.
title: Настоящие Детективы

overview: The Eleventh Hour also known as Eleventh Hour Presents appeared on Channel 4 from 1982 to 1988 that included screenings of Noel Burch's film 'The Year of the Bodyguard' and Lezli-An Barrett's film 'An Epic Poem', both about suffragettes, followed by a discussion between critic Pam Cook and independent filmmakers Noel Burch and Lezli-an Barrett about gender issues in film history.
title: The Eleventh Hour

overview: Li Ya'er acts as his father's proxy to receive the bride who dies in a mysterious fire that very night. He is then attacked, loses his memory, and is enslaved. When a bloody conspiracy collides with the secrets of his identity, master and servant are forced into a tragic confrontation. Behind the masks lie true hearts, and beneath the strange case, deep feelings surge. Witness how a dual-faced princess and a cold-eyed killer join forces to unravel a conspiracy and protect the Tang Dynasty under the cover of darkness!
title: Treacherous Cases in Shendu

overview: Diego joins the Peace Corps to win back his ex-girlfriend. He imagines exotic locales, instead he finds himself "Lost in Moldova." Follow his adventures as he navigates the cultural differences that divide us and the shared humor and humanity that unites us.
title: Lost in Moldova

overview: Black Death Patient Zero explores the origins of the 14th-century Black Death pandemic, using new DNA analysis to investigate its earliest victims. The show investigates the plague's spread from Central Asia, with filming locations in the UK, Italy, and Germany, and highlights scientific efforts to trace the pandemic's roots, such as the study of plague victims found in Kyrgyzstan in 1338 or 1339.
title: Black Death Patient Zero

overview: Most Wanted - A hajsza is RTL's new interactive escape reality show. 24 well-known Hungarian celebrities try to escape from Balázs Sebestyén and his team of professional pursuers - without a phone or money, dressed in orange prison uniforms. The goal: to evade the hunters. Viewers could also join the action - reporting if they spotted any of the fugitives, or even helping them escape through online platforms and social media. The format engaged the entire country, with thousands of reports submitted and hundreds of people offering assistance to the celebrities.
title: Most Wanted - A hajsza

overview: The past haunts, the grand prize tempts! Which couple will be able to move beyond past grievances and work together for victory and a prize of up to 40 million forints? In the special game Exek csatája, participants reunite solely for the sake of the reality show. Their goal is to complete challenging tasks while skillfully navigating the emotional tensions between them. The competition isn't just about the potential 40 million forint prize - it's also about proving that the past doesn't have to hold them back from overcoming the challenges of the present.
title: Exek csatája

overview: Vincent, an heir to a news empire, gets accused of killing his rival, Walter. To protect his reputation, he hires Stella, an escort with her own haunted past, to pose as his alibi. What begins as a transactional arrangement soon becomes dangerously real as their shared wounds and ambitions draw them together. But when they uncover the truth, the two are compelled to confront their true feelings.
title: The Alibi

overview: Aubrey drives a load of 'Doggy Dins' dog food from Carmarthen to Hull, and Dan drives a load of 'Bona Fido' dog food from Hull to Carmarthen. They soon find - or rather don't find - that they have more in common than they think.
title: Dogfood Dan and the Carmarthen Cowboy

overview: A show in which comedians don't discuss cars, politics or sports, but... fatherhood!
title: ПАПАШИ

overview: This is a nostalgic show from Otar Kushanashvili and Roman Kositsyn. If you remember how you brought one roll to a tea party and ate two, then this show is just for you. Our guests are nostalgic for the nineties and two thousandths, answer questions and participate in activities related to that time.
title: НОСТАЛЬЖИ

overview: The Arrangement is an American competitive reality television series featuring ten floral arrangers. The contestants face challenges in each episode to win the title of "America's Best Floral Designer" and win a prize package of a Smart Fortwo Passion Coupe and $25,000.
title: The Arrangement

overview: "Listen to what Happened" is a new true edge show from the DELA community. This is a homely, cozy podcast in which guests come to the hosts Masha and Dasha to discuss stories about serial killers, cults, robberies, mysterious cases, unsolved stories. These are our interests. Make yourself comfortable, turn off the light and pour the tea. It's going to be creepy and interesting.
title: ПОСЛУШАЙ, ЧТО СЛУЧИЛОСЬ

overview: After being suspended from duty and only able to work under the supervision of a psychotherapist, Homicide Squad Commissioner Sare Baykal faces the most complicated murder of her career, while her path crosses with fashion photographer Atlas Demiroğlu, who came to the police station because of a film full of mysterious images. The investigation, which begins with a woman's body found in an amusement park, soon opens the doors to a multi-layered puzzle that extends to both Sare and Atlas' pasts. As each new clue draws Sare and Atlas into a dark labyrinth, the boundaries between reality, fantasy, loyalty and betrayal become increasingly blurred.
title: Son Kare

overview: Their breathing is ragged, their strength is at its limit, and each new stage is harder than the last. No staged scenes – only real emotions. Pushing a 150-kilogram log, then climbing without safety equipment, and after that, without a break, heading to the firing range. It's not just difficult – the obstacle course exhausts even seasoned athletes, and special forces veterans drop out of the race. Steep climbs, sharp descents, challenges at high altitudes. Participants need ingenuity and extreme focus. "Победители" is the first tactical extreme sports project on Russian television. Teams led by Mikhail Koklyaev, Ed Khalilov, Marat Sutaev, and Svetlana Aplachkina will compete for the main prize, provided by REN TV in partnership with PSB Bank. Each of the mentors is a recognized master in their sport. And each of them has formed a team based on their own plan for victory. In this honest and tough competition, the teams become stronger, their characters tougher. Drama in every episode, intrigue until the very end, and victory here will not come easily.
title: Победители

overview: Heather Gay, star of "The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City" and New York Times bestselling author of "Bad Mormon," uncovers the dark history of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints in "Surviving Mormonism with Heather Gay." The first episode premieres Tuesday, Nov. 11 at 9:15 p.m. ET/PT on Bravo, following a supersized episode of "The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City." All three parts will drop exclusively on Peacock on Nov. 12. The three-part limited series fractures the church's seemingly perfect veneer to expose the secrets that have been kept behind closed doors. In each hourlong episode, Heather has impactful conversations with abuse survivors, ex-Mormons and former LDS church leaders. As Heather reflects on her own departure from the church, "Surviving Mormonism" delves into outdated and controversial practices and empowers victims to share their experiences to bring awareness and enact change.
title: Surviving Mormonism with Heather Gay

overview: It follows Tom and Petra, a successful couple who built up a large Ica Maxi store in Linköping and sold it for a record sum to live a life of luxury in Mallorca with their sons. Ready to enjoy an eternal vacation, their lives suddenly take an unexpected turn during Tom's 50th birthday party, leading his brother Timmy and his wife Maja to move their family to the sunny Spanish island, where chaos ensues.
title: Där solen alltid skiner

overview: The Gudov family lives in a small village near Moscow. Sergei is the head of a close—knit family, he has everything in order: a faithful wife, a marriageable daughter, a farm, a house. He considers his brother Semyon to be a rotten branch on the family tree. After all, Semyon is a disgrace to the Goodovs' honest name, instead of a normal business, he commands a cemetery, sauna and microloans. Sergei only lacks an heir, but suddenly Matvey appears in his house — a charming orphan boy who claims that he is his illegitimate son. From this moment on, the family idyll turns into a test for everyone, and the treacherous brother secretly seeks to take the family land for himself.
title: Гудовы

overview: Real celebrities. Really saucy stories. Mel Giedroyc hosts the erotic showbiz book club where famous guests narrate racy fanfiction while naughty puppets bring their words vividly to life!
title: No Strings Attached

overview: Hafsa, a talented art restorer freshly hired at the Louvre, plunges into chaos when she comes face to face with a millennial mask of the storm god "Belphegor". Suddenly involved in a series of inexplicable disappearances, a race against time begins for her. To bring out the truth, Hafsa will have to fight against those who stake her... and against her ghosts.
title: Belphégor

overview: Denise is an ordinary woman. Or almost. From a very young age, she has heard people's thoughts. No spirit resists him. How, under these conditions, to play the game of life in society? How to maintain a relationship of couple, friendship, family? How to love, how to be loved? Can we reasonably be lucid and happy at the same time?
title: Extra-Lucide

overview: Milan, QT8 neighborhood. Anna, Luca, and Marco are three young people with a passion for rap music. When a prestigious record label takes notice of them, the three believe their breakthrough is near, but in the neighborhood nothing is ever guaranteed, and the group must contend with a drug dealer who doesn't want their success. With music by Ernia.
title: Hype

overview: Dustin, a half-baked film major from LA, is sent to NYC to stay with- and make a documentary about- his uncle Henry, a supposedly ultra-successful Broadway actor. However, upon arrival, Dustin discovers a hidden truth: Henry shares a cramped apartment with an eccentric roommate Marlon. Worse, they scrape by performing as Elmo and Cookie Monster in Times Square. This is their story.
title: Les Mascots

overview: E! reporters provide ringside coverage of celebrity arrivals on the red carpet at Hollywood events and premieres. From the Grammys and the Emmys to the Golden Globes and the Oscars and all awards ceremonies and premieres in between, cameras keep a close eye on the flair, the fashion, the glitz and the glamour only on E!'s Live from the Red Carpet.
title: Live from E!

overview: In this fantasy investigation series, investigators from two eras must hunt for the truth in old unsolved cases, communicating only through an old radio. The signal between the past and the present only opens at 23:23.

Five friends, acquaintances of the beer machine, from different professions, ages, and fate, threw off the bottle. And out of the bottle came a fairy named Bereginya, obliged to fulfill all the bottle owners' wishes.
title: Аптекарь
